g.title: MPMQSP
g.text: Malignant Pleural Mesothelioma — QSP mechanistic map
the tumour written as a sheet (area × thickness) rather than a ball ·one-sided delivery and the geometric sanctuary ·mRECIST measures thickness only · the pleural space as a compartment with a volume
